About Nayabs

Nayabs Johar Town, Lahore ka aik mashhoor Pakistani / desi buffet restaurant hai — jahan khana sirf khana nahi, poori dawat hoti hai. Wasee buffet spread, rooftop dining aur group gatherings ke liye mozoon mahol — family dinners hon ya doston ki mehfil, Nayabs har moqe ke liye tayyar hai.

Menu ki pehchan is ki khaas dishes hain: Butter Mutton Karahi, Achari Chicken Handi, Tawa Piece, Butter Chicken, BBQ Platter aur Chicken Chilman Biryani — sath me cheese naan aur fresh bakery. Weekend par Hi-Tea Buffet bhi chalti hai.

Hamari Specialities

Nayabs ki sab se zyada pasand ki jane wali dishes — buffet ke sath sath alag se bhi order karein.

Butter Mutton Karahi

Naram mutton, makkhan aur tamatar ki garhi gravy — Nayabs ki sab se khaas karahi, naan ke sath lazmi try karein.

Achari Chicken Handi

Achar ke chatpate masale me bani chicken handi — tez, khushboodar aur bilkul desi zaiqa.

BBQ Platter

Seekh kabab, tikka aur grill ki poori thaali — group aur family sharing ke liye behtareen.

Chicken Chilman Biryani

Dum par pakki khushboodar biryani — har daane me masala, upar garam chicken piece.

Butter Chicken & Cheese Naan

Creamy butter chicken, upar pighla makkhan — garam cheese naan ke sath kamaal ka combination.

Buffet & Fresh Bakery

Wasee desi buffet aur rozana ki fresh bakery — khane ke baad meetha bhi yahi se.

Note: Is page par lagi tasaveerein representative hain. Asal dishes aur mahol ke liye Nayabs visit karein ya Instagram par @nayabspk dekhein.

Weekend Hi-Tea Buffet

Har Jumma, Hafta aur Itwaar — do slots me hi-tea buffet. Family aur doston ke sath shaam guzarne ka behtareen plan.
